annotation.title_clean: The Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence Use in Member States of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC)
annotation.title_en: The Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence Use in Member States of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC)
annotation.venue: GCC General Secretariat / GCC eGovernment portal
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Non-binding GCC guidance setting four values and seven principles for ethical AI use across member states, drawing on the UNESCO 2021 Recommendation. It covers human decision-making, safety, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability and integrity, and stresses respect for Islamic Sharia. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four values: human dignity and autonomy, respect for Islamic Sharia and Gulf unity, environmental sustainability, peaceful use for well-being
Seven principles: human decision-making, safety, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability, integrity
Recommends human oversight, rollback mechanisms and fundamental rights impact assessments
Recommends legislation assigning legal accountability to identifiable entities, not to AI systems, plus independent audits
Encourages national AI ethics committees and use of the guide in national legislation and strategies
